semiconductor_relevance: High — Teikoku Taping Systems provides essential equipment and materials for back-end semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Teikoku Taping Systems specializes in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and materials, focusing on back-end processes such as laminators, wafer mounters, and UV-curable epoxy resins for encapsulation. They are developing next-generation laminators for panel-level packaging and offer a range of cleaning agents and stripping solutions for semiconductor and LCD panel manufacturing.
capabilities: UV-curable epoxy resins for semiconductor encapsulants

regional_presence.Japan: Teikoku Taping Systems primarily conducts business in Japan, focusing on the domestic market for their cleaning agents and stripping solutions.
regional_presence.China: The company has a presence in China, targeting the semiconductor manufacturing sector.
regional_presence.Taiwan: Teikoku Taping Systems operates in Taiwan, catering to local semiconductor manufacturers.
regional_presence.ASEAN: They are involved in the ASEAN region, providing products to semiconductor companies.
regional_presence.EU: The company also has a strategic presence in the European market.
